subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: 'Wings of Fire', an autobiography describing a journey from a humble background to becoming President of India, was written by:
explanation: 'Wings of Fire' (1999) is Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam's autobiography, tracing his path from Rameswaram to becoming India's 'Missile Man' and later President.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Books & Authors — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Rabindranath Tagore, the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature (1913), won it for which work?
explanation: Tagore won the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature for 'Gitanjali' ('Song Offerings'), a collection of poems. Gora, Ghare Baire and Kabuliwala are other notable works by him, but not the prize-winning one.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch28 — Books & Authors — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: India's National Song 'Vande Mataram' was composed by:
explanation: 'Vande Mataram', from Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's novel 'Anandamath', is India's National Song. Tagore separately composed the National Anthem 'Jana Gana Mana'.
